The '''LCK 2024 Spring''' Split was the first split of the 2024 season of the [[League of Legends Champions Korea]], organized by Riot Games. The competition ran from January 17 to April 14, with the Regular Season held offline at LoL Park in Seoul and the Lower Bracket Final and Grand Final played at the KSPO Dome. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin Regular Season using best-of-three matches, with the top six advancing to a Double Elimination Playoffs played as best-of-five. The winner and runner-up qualified for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2024|Mid-Season Invitational]]. The split was played across patches 14.1 through 14.6, with Smolder, Neeko, and Azir disabled at various points for competitive reasons.

==Format==
*'''Regular Season'''
**Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to Round 2 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd till 6th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 10th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
*'''Playoffs'''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner and the runner-up qualify for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2024|Mid-Season Invitational 2024]]
